jobs.occupation: We are searching for CNC Industrial Technician to work in Denmark, Skagen
jobs.description:
Unique job opportunity in Skagen! Solid machining company is ready to welcome your expertise in CNC and programming.

This is a permanent position, but if moving permanently to Denmark is not an option for you, it is entirely possible to work in a rotation arrangement.

We expect you to:

• 
be knowledgeable and have experience in MasterCam 2023 version or newer version. We work in 2026 version

• 
be comfortable and knowledgeable in Turning and/or Milling

• 
be comfortable and knowledgeable in 3-5 axis machining and programming

• 
be able to set up machines and tools

• 
Perform self-inspection and prepare measurement reports

• 
Be a constructive partner for both colleagues and customers

• 
Plan and propose cost savings and process improvements

• 
Deliver products with the right quality at the right time

• 
Training is provided in the use of special equipment

We imagine that you are a true CNC enthusiast who values quality and professional challenges. You have a vocational education or equivalent in technical subjects, preferably as a CNC operator. Relevant experience can compensate for lack of education. In addition, we want you to have at least 3-5 years of experience as a CNC operator, preferably in advanced machining and complex items.

Your collaboration skills are good, and you communicate well in English. We are a small, flexible and motivated group of people who work closely together and are proud to deliver high quality. We therefore want you to have a good work ethic, because after all, it is we who pull the load together. We work well together, but everyone has their own tasks, so you must also be able to work independently. Sometimes we have a lot to do, so it is important that you thrive in a hectic work environment and have an extra gear when necessary.

We offer:

• 
New facilities

• 
Qualification salary (you grow with your job, so will your salary)

• 
New challenges in a new environment

• 
Variation and versatile work duties

• 
Life Insurance + pension plan

• 
Free healthcare in Denmark

• 
Small fitness center on site

• 
Help to get you set up in Denmark (bank, work visa, a place to stay, TAX, Etc.)

About us:

Grenen Maskinfabrik ApS is a small, solid and innovative company, with roots dating back to 1925! We take pride in providing quality service to customers at all levels.

The company is partly Norwegian and delivers products to Norway and the rest of the world. Since its inception in 2011, we have managed to position ourselves as a strong player in the industry.

We have invested in several new CNC machines, in addition to moving into new premises in 2021,  in a 1620 m2 machine hall, you will be able to utilize your professional expertise, learn a lot of new things and have fun at work at the same time! Here you will be taken care of by colleagues and employees who are concerned with quality, challenges and well-being in everyday life.

If this sounds like something for you, send us your application and CV to mfl@gmfabrik.dk

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Best Regards,

Grenen Maskinfabrik ApS Team

jobs.occupation: DEKRA-owned Force Aerospace Testing is looking for NDT Engineers
jobs.description:
Work with Aviation. Build Your Future with DEKRA.

At DEKRA, you will work in an environment where technology, safety, and real world operations come together. You will be part of a global organization supporting the aviation industry through specialized inspection and testing services that help ensure reliability and safety across airports and aircraft operations.

This role offers a unique combination of technical responsibility, mobility, and personal freedom. You will work hands on with aircraft and components across the Nordic region while continuously developing your expertise in a highly specialized field.

For someone who enjoys technology, variation, and practical problem solving, this is an opportunity to build a long term career in an industry where quality and precision truly matter.

What will you do?

As an NDT Technician at DEKRA, you will:

    

Perform Non Destructive Testing (NDT) on aircraft, helicopters, and components

    

Work with several different aircraft types and technical environments

    

Travel extensively to customer sites and airports across the Nordic region, with occasional international assignments

    

Work closely with customers, suppliers, and colleagues while contributing to safety, reliability, and quality within aviation maintenance

 The role offers a high degree of freedom, mobility, and responsibility, making it ideal for someone who enjoys variation, technical challenges, and working in dynamic environments.

Who are we looking for? We are looking for someone with a strong technical mindset who enjoys practical work, takes responsibility, and thrives in an environment where no two days look exactly the same.

We believe you have:

    

Certification within the following NDT methods:  EN9712- ET2, UT1 and PT2

    

Good communication skills in English

    

A valid driver’s license (B)

    

Good computer skills

    

Flexibility and willingness to travel and work away from home 

It is considered a strong advantage if you also have:

    

Previous experience within aviation, for example as an aircraft mechanic/technician or in a similar technical role

    

Certification according to EN4179

    

Knowledge of Swedish, Danish, or another Nordic language

Personal qualities will be an important part of the selection process. We are looking for someone who is reliable, curious, adaptable, and motivated by continuous learning and development. You enjoy taking responsibility, solving technical challenges, and adapting to different customer environments and situations. 

Get go know DEKRA

DEKRA is one of the world’s leading expert organizations within safety, inspection, testing, and certification. With operations in more than 60 countries, DEKRA works across several industries to help create safer systems, workplaces, and technologies.

Within aviation, DEKRA supports customers with specialized technical expertise and inspection services focused on safety, quality, and reliability.

This is a direct recruitment where you will be employed directly by DEKRA, while Qlose manages the recruitment process.

 Have we caught your interest?

Great, that’s usually a good sign 🌟

Click “Apply now” and attach your CV or LinkedIn profile, and we’ll take it from there. We work with continuous selection, so don’t wait too long, we appreciate curiosity and people who like to take initiative.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact Linnea at linnea.neldemo@qlose.io

Vacation season? Same here! 🌞 During the summer holiday period (weeks 28–31), our team will be operating with reduced staffing, so our response time may be a little longer than usual. Feel free to apply today – we look forward to reviewing your application as soon as we're back!

Sales Specialist - Unified Communication

GlobalConnect, Multiple locations

Are you our new Sales Specialist?

Are you our new Sales Specialist? We are seeking a motivated Sales Specialist to join our Business Management team focused on Contact Center, Cloud PBX and Voice services:

· Primarily working across the Nordics while also supporting activities in Germany. This role can be based in Copenhagen, Stockholm or Oslo.

Reporting to the Head of Business Management, you will join a collaborative team operating across the Nordic region and Germany, contributing to go-to-market execution and customer engagement.

Key responsibilities

In this role, you will:

· Manage customer interactions end-to-end: sales presentations, quotations, service demonstrations and responses to tenders.

· Act as a subject matter expert for our UC product portfolio and present tailored solutions to customers.

· Drive opportunities to closure in close collaboration with Key Account Managers.

· Build and develop a strong pipeline and close opportunities.

About you

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (advantageous; not required).

Common requirements

· 5+ years of experience in Contact Center, Cloud PBX, and/or Voice sales.

· Proven background in both presales and sales activities.

· Self-motivated, results-driven and able to inspire others.

· Strong ownership, efficient execution, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

· Team player with a proactive mindset who embraces challenges and aims to make a measurable difference.

Role-specific requirements

· Fluent in one Nordic language (Danish, Swedish or Norwegian) AND English and German. Experience launching or scaling UC services in a new market is a plus.

Location

· Copenhagen, Stockholm or Oslo, with frequent collaboration with our Hamburg office.

Application

· Start Date: As soon as possible, preferably by 1 October 2026.

· Application Deadline: 15 July 2026.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply early. For questions about the role, please contact:

Per Svahn

Head of Business Management

Phone: +46 735 225 037

About us

GlobalConnect operates in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Germany, bringing together employees from diverse nationalities. We connect people and organizations across society, starting with our robust digital infrastructure and extending to the solutions we enable. Our mission is to simplify complexity and uphold our customer promise of being easy to work with.

Owned by EQT, GlobalConnect is the fastest-growing provider of connectivity solutions and digital infrastructure in Northern Europe. With operations in Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Germany, and Finland, our 2 300 employees ensure we are the leading challenger in each market, delivering secure and future-proof solutions to some of the world’s largest companies, private households, and everything in between.

For over two decades, we have contributed to the development and digitization of societies across the Nordics. Our purpose drives us forward—turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

jobs.occupation: Sales Oriented Business Manager to ALTEN Denmark
jobs.description:
Would you like to work in a varied role with a focus on sales, recruitment and leadership? Then we have the position for you! ALTEN Group is seeking to appoint a Business Manager with the aim to develop our business to the Danish market. 
 
As Business Manager, you will be responsible for establishing and developing the ALTEN organization in Denmark where you will report directly to the Managing Director of Sweden. 

To be considered for the role as Business Manager, you are required to have a master degree within engineering or business as well as 3 to 5 years’ relevant experience of working within sales and/or recruitment. Furthermore, you are fluent in both Danish and English, spoken as well as written. Experience of the IT or Technology consultancy business is meritorious. 

As a person, you are committed with a strong interest in sales and business development. You appreciate challenges and have a goal-oriented mindset. You prefer working in a fast-paced and inconstant environment. In addition to this, you are good at establishing and maintaining relationships with other people.

The position is located in Copenhagen but frequent travel will occur, both nationally and internationally. Your main responsibilities as Business Manager are: 
- Prospection and sales towards new and existent clients
- Managing the entire recruitment process, from need to hiring
- Managing the group of consultants you have hired 
- Coaching, support and career development of your consultants 
- Producing accurate business forecasts and reports for your Business Unit
- Budget responsibility for your Business Unit About ALTEN Group
With over 30 000 employees in 22 countries, we develop and deliver competence for world leading companies through the most committed engineering and IT consultants. Our customers are found in industries such as Energy, Telecom, Automotive, Defence & Aerospace and Life Science and we are active throughout the whole product lifecycle. We offer you an interesting role in an international environment with a clearly defined career ladder for your own development. As Business Manager, you also have both international and national educations as well as regular coaching.

jobs.occupation: Junior Sourcing Specialist, Swedish speaking for ProData Consult, Denmark
jobs.description:

Headhunt new relevant Consultants to the Swedish database
